title: The Pocket of Smooth Cove Stones
youtube_title: The Pocket of Smooth Cove Stones | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Sharing what you collected can give someone else a way to join in.
summary: Hana has a pocket full of smooth stones for a seaside picture, and when her cousin Bram arrives with nothing to add, she shares the stones so they can build the picture together.
